item.description:
### Added
- Settings › General › Thumbnails on screen: how many thumbnails show before the rest fold into "+N" — 3 to 6, 4 by default. - Click "+N" to see the folded thumbnails beside the others; Show Less, or moving the pointer away, folds them again. - Move the thumbnails with two fingers on the trackpad, from anywhere on them.
### Changed
- The newest thumbnail is always on top.
### Fixed
- A fifth capture no longer leaves only three thumbnails on screen. - Copy in the editor puts the file on the clipboard too, so it pastes into Finder and the terminal; the button says Copied. ⌘C copies the text selected in Recognized Text. - A recording no longer shows thumbnails or pins that appear while it runs. - The app no longer carries a stray copy of the App Store build's settings file.
